text: You think rejection hurts? Try getting rejected by your future wife 7 times. Let me tell you something, I tried to shoot at this girl in high school and she told me no. Then I shot again, she told me no again. Shot again a couple years later and she told me no for the 7th time. I kept showing up, not on some creepy stuff, but on some consistent, confident, and undeniable type energy. No doesn't mean never. And no really don't hurt. It just means not right now. Couple years later, I ended up marrying that woman. She taught me the real art of closing. Persistence, patience, and presence. If you can keep your composure after being told no, you can literally close anything. If this man can close anything, how about he closes the chapter of his life where he behaved like a spineless doormat with no boundaries and no self-respect. Because calling 7 rejections persistence is wild. That's not confidence. That's a man refusing to accept reality because he's terrified of putting himself first. Chasing a girl for years after repeated rejections isn't romantic. It's a self-esteem issue. You can pursue a woman, sure. You can initiate, ask her out, take your shot. If she says yes, great. Move through the stages and develop the story. If she says no, you can try once more later. But if she hits you with another no, that's it. Respect yourself, wish her well, and walk away. That's what men with dignity do. Because let's be honest about what really happened here. Whatever made her suddenly say yes after rejecting him 7 times is probably not a good reason. She didn't magically wake up, attracted to him. More likely, she spent those years dating other men, sleeping around, trying to find someone she genuinely wanted. And when that didn't work out, when she got tired or disappointed, or her options slowed down, she remembered she had a loyal doormat waiting in the background who would provide stability and resources. So she settled. And do you honestly think a relationship like that has a strong future? A husband with no boundaries or experience, and a wife who chose him only after exhausting everything else? He will spend his life trying to keep her interested, while her appetites rise and rise, until someone better shows up. It is sad, but it is real. Men, stop chasing where you are not wanted. Choose women who choose you back.
